授業概要
種々の今日的な環境問題を把握・解決するための、環境地理学・政策学の理論・手法について議論する。これにより、環境地理学・政策学の視点から、環境問題の要因を解明するとともに、その解決方法も探求する。地域環境政策論Ⅱでは、環境都市問題の要因を解明する方法とともに、その解決方法について概観する。
The purpose of this course is to discuss theories and methods base on environmental geography and policy studies so as to identify and solve a various contemporary environmental problems. At the end of this class, participants will be able to identify determinants of these problems, and also to explore solutions for them from the viewpoints of environmental geography and policy studies. In the Regional Environmental Policy II, we learn how to identify causes of environmental problems in cities and how to solve them.

全体の教育目標
人類が直面する種々の環境問題の現状を把握し、これらの問題を、環境地理学・政策学の視点から解明し、よりよい社会像を提示・構築するための理論と方法を学ぶ。
After the completion of this course, participants will be able to:
・understand a variety of current environmental issues the human being is facing from the viewpoints of environmental geography and policy studies.
・acquire theories and methods to identify determinants of and solutions for these issues towards construction of better societies.
